neighbours.label: an intensifier that adds emphasis (like a lot, like really low, desperately, very strongly, すごく), as opposed to the same sentences without it
fire: I love that band.. like a lot. Haha.
The water was very cold, like really cold.
The data were very strongly supported.
思ったより美味しくて、すごく気に入りました。
She was extremely happy with the result.
We were absolutely thrilled to see them.
quiet: I saw that band in my town. Haha.
The water was on the table in the hall.
He wanted to leave on Friday.
The data were stored in a file.
美味しくて、気に入りました。
She was at home with her family.
